episodes.186310: Scattered showers and storms developed over western Pennsylvania during the afternoon of December 3, 2023, just ahead of an approaching cold front. In a high shear environment, a meager amount of CAPE developed when the sun briefly broke out west of the mountains. This was enough to generate some embedded thunderstorms, some of which contained small hail, and one storm produced a report of wind damage in Clearfield County.
episodes.187208: A severe thunderstorm developed over portions of the Southern Tier and Genesee Valley as a strong trough and convective system tracked across the area. The warning was issued for one inch hail, wind gusts to 60 mph and a tornado possible. The storm resulted in a downed tree in the Town of Hume in Allegany County.
episodes.187762: A cold front moved through the area, producing around 2 inches of rain in the vicinity of Knoxville and Sevierville.
episodes.187822: A pair of moderate atmospheric rivers brought heavy rain leading to minor river and urban flooding to portions of northwest Oregon.
episodes.189515: Northern Ohio resided within the cool sector on the backside of an occluded surface low during the afternoon of the 3rd as the low moved from near southern Lake Michigan to western NY.  Simultaneously, a surface trough axis swept generally eastward through northern OH and triggered scattered multicell rain showers and thunderstorms amidst weak MUCAPE, steep mid-level lapse rates near 8C/km, and moderate effective bulk shear. A cluster of multicell thunderstorms produced hail up to penny-size in northern Summit County during the late afternoon.

events.narrative: Minor flooding was reported by law enforcement.

Spotter reported a rockslide on Highway 36, with small trees down, but could move around them. Tripcheck showed rockslide between Rainrock and Swisshome, OR. Areas of running water over Highway 36 and the train tracks was also observed.
A man fell into Johnson Creek and drowned. Moderate to heavy rainfall December 2nd through 3rd produced bank full conditions and swift moving water in the creek.
Hail up to penny-size in Macedonia.
Hail up to penny-size about one mile NNE of Twinsburg.
A tree was downed in Hume.
A severe thunderstorm producing winds estimated near 60 mph knocked down power lines near Morrisdale.
The Siuslaw river at Mapleton rose above minor flood stage after noon on December 3rd and crested at 18.7 feet at 6 PM. Flood stage is 18.0 feet.
